title: Detail Option Value
description: An option value with availability signals relative to the effective selections, used in detail product responses.

id.description: Optional server-assigned identifier for this option value. When present in a selected_option, the server SHOULD use it for matching instead of label.

label.description: Display text for this option value (e.g., 'Small', 'Blue').

available.description: Whether this option value is available given the other current selections. False indicates a sold-out or otherwise unselectable combination.
